fitted.rule: twice the slowest measured complete run of each hook
fitted.plan_rule: a planner's model call: twice the slowest measured call; a question: that bound times the most calls any measured question made
fitted.conditions: measured 2026-10-22 02:30-03:01 beside compiler builds (build/avra compiles running); that inflates the timings, the safe direction. The slowest call (39 s) includes the first call's model load. Only the 8 questions that reached a plan (16 calls) are measured; the 28 refused questions left no call times.
